data.name: Create Invoice Item
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates an invoice line item through Apideck's unified accounting API. Use it to add a billable item to an accounting resource.
Use for: add invoice item, create line item, record item details
Not supported: creating invoices, retrieving items, updating or deleting items

data.name: PUT Create an Anthropic inference endpoint
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates an Elasticsearch inference endpoint configured for Anthropic. Use it to register an inference service for Elasticsearch workloads.
Use for: configure Anthropic inference, register endpoint, set inference service
Not supported: generating text, querying documents, managing Nvidia or ELSER endpoints

data.name: Create Invoice
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates an invoice through Apideck's unified accounting API. Use it to add a new invoice to a connected accounting system.
Use for: create invoice, issue customer invoice, record invoice
Not supported: creating invoice items, retrieving invoices, updating or deleting invoices

data.name: Create an Invoice with Customer Id
data.description: You can use this API to  create an invoice by passing the customer_id.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a Razorpay invoice using a customer identifier. Use it to issue an invoice associated with an existing customer.
Use for: create customer invoice, issue invoice, associate customer
Not supported: payment capture, retrieving invoices, updating or deleting invoices
